 Nepal Premier League Cricket: Two Crucial Matches Today
 Ratopati
 November 12, 2026
 Read in Nepali
 Kathmandu. Two important matches are being played today, Thursday, in the third edition of the Nepal Premier League (NPL) cricket. The first match will be played at 12:30 PM between Biratnagar Kings and Pokhara Avengers at the TU International Cricket Ground. The second match will start at 5 PM between Karnali Yaks and Lumbini Lions. Both matches are expected to be very exciting regarding the playoff race equation. Based on the results of the 21 matches played so far, Lumbini is in third place in the table with 7 points from 5 matches. Biratnagar and Karnali, who have played 5 matches each, have accumulated 4 points each. Pokhara, with only 2 points from 5 matches, is at the bottom of the points table (eighth place). While Lumbini is in a strong position, Biratnagar and Karnali are under pressure to win to keep their playoff hopes alive. Pokhara, which registered its first win in the previous match, will also be looking to continue that momentum. First Match: Biratnagar Kings vs. Pokhara Avengers Biratnagar Kings, in the 5 matches played in this edition, have won 2 and lost 3, accumulating 4 points and occupying the sixth position. Biratnagar suffered an 8-run defeat against Chitwan Rhinos in the first match and was defeated by Karnali Yaks by 4 wickets in the second match. However, they secured two consecutive wins by defeating Sudurpashchim Royals by 35 runs in the third match and Janakpur Bolts by 2 runs in the fourth match. Nevertheless, they suffered a wide 9-wicket defeat against Kathmandu Gorkhas in the fifth match. The performance of players like Lokesh Bam, Martin Guptill, Sam Hilllett, and Andre Russell will be important for Biratnagar's batting. Captain Sandeep Lamichhane's role could be decisive in bowling. On the other hand, Thursday's match is a golden opportunity for Pokhara Avengers to maintain their winning streak. Pokhara, which lost its first four matches consecutively (by 6 wickets against Sudurpashchim, by 9 runs against Janakpur, by 8 wickets against Lumbini, and by 30 runs against Chitwan), tasted a happy victory in the tournament by defeating Karnali Yaks by 63 runs in the fifth match. In the last match, Pokhara, which scored a huge total of 217 runs for the loss of 3 wickets in 20 overs against Karnali, has proven its batting prowess. In response, Pokhara, which managed to dismiss Karnali for 154 runs, will see significant performances from foreign players including captain Kushal Bhurtel, Adam Rossington, and Richard Levy. After consecutive losses, Pokhara wants to repeat the same magic against Biratnagar. Second Match: Lumbini Lions vs. Karnali Yaks Both Lumbini Lions and Karnali Yaks, who are set to clash in the second match on Thursday, will be in search of a win. Lumbini, performing excellently in the tournament, is in third place with 7 points from 5 matches. Lumbini, which defeated Sudurpashchim Royals by 7 wickets in the first match, had its second match (against Chitwan) declared a no-result due to rain. Lumbini defeated Pokhara Avengers by 8 wickets in the third match and Janakpur Bolts by 16 runs in the fourth match, but its unbeaten streak ended with a 34-run defeat against Kathmandu Gorkhas in the fifth match. Therefore, Lumbini's main goal will be to return to form by securing a win against Karnali. The performance of players like captain Rohit Paudel, Darcy Short, Ruben Trumpelmann, Sher Malla, and Tilak Bhandari will be important for Lumbini. Lumbini, which appears balanced in both batting and bowling, wants to maintain its strong aspect. On the other hand, Karnali Yaks is in seventh place with 4 points from 5 matches. Karnali had a brilliant start by defeating Janakpur Bolts by 19 runs in the first match and Biratnagar Kings by 4 wickets in the second match, but lost the next three consecutive matches. Karnali is under a lot of pressure after suffering a 4-wicket defeat against Kathmandu Gorkhas in the third match, a 39-run defeat against Sudurpashchim Royals in the fourth match, and a 63-run defeat against Pokhara Avengers in the fifth match. To strengthen their playoff chances, Karnali is compelled to win against Lumbini. The performance of key players like Mark Watt, Priyank Panchal, and Pawan Sarraf will be decisive for Karnali. Failure to get a good start in batting has been Karnali's main weakness. In the league stage of the NPL, each team will play seven matches each. With eight teams participating in this competition, the top four teams will qualify for the playoffs, so the results of both matches on Thursday will have a profound impact on the points table equation.
